title: Main Dashboard Rules
brands: Proposed dashboard standard (Branding, Oct 17 2026). Option A is always the live state found in the review (harness shots at 393 and 1280 of every unlocked board, 22:20 ICT); Option B is the proposed rule.
Max's standard: white and light beige (#fff, #FAF6EE, #e3ddd2), Khand and Hind, square corners, light mode only, no emoji.
request: Max, Oct 17 2026 10:15-10:16 PM ICT: review every dashboard, overall rules for all dashboards, especially the main dashboard; propose changes in a deck.

sources.pictures: img/dashboard-standard (HTML mocks of live boards, neutral text)
